output.summary: The 3 scenarios and 10 tests I was given all have verdicts: 4 consistent (CORE-02, ORIG-03, and 3 of the tests) and the rest not-related. The Heroic Inspiration behaviour lives in test_core02d_* and test_orig03_human_inspiration, which agree with the unit. The ORIG-01 items and the Advantage and Halfling Luck tests only matched on the term. No engine code carries `SRD[GLOSS.heroic-inspiration…]`. The page-183 candidates in actions.py, combat.py, creature.py, damage.py, effects.py and explore.py are about Hide, Knocking Out, Help and jumping, so they get no verdicts. The clause "must use the new roll" is only asserted incidentally. Nothing checks the ambiguous points, namely a single die versus the whole roll, the timing window, and only your own dice.
